title: Corpus Christi band photo of 1917 and identifying its players
summary: Identifying band members in the 1917 Corpus Christi photo, including Sidney Desvigne, George Moore and Vic Gaspard.

bands.name: Corpus Christi Holy Name Society Band

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I don't think you saw this one. This is Carpus Christi.
He's right here, too. Carpus Christi Holy Name Society.
Something about New Orleans under there. January. January 1917.
New Orleans, Louisiana.
They took that over here, was it?
Yeah, that's right here. That was in 1917.

There he is. Oh, you mean from the church, right? Yes. That's why I made my first communion. Sure. When he said Carpus Christi, I thought Carpus Christi, Texas, you know. Since he traveled so much, I thought it was in the church.
Yeah, sure. It's the church. There he is. Where is he? Finding that? He's right behind his band. There he is.
That's Anor Land. This is Sidney Desween right here.
Oh, Sidney Desween is almost in the back of the bass drum.
Yeah, Anor is right behind his drum arm. Oh, I'm right behind you.
And he's George Moritz. It was a drum arm.
The trombone looks familiar, too, but I can't think of it. You never hear him, George Moritz? He was a very good trumpet. Yes, I've heard people mention him.
I don't know everybody on there, but...
Yeah?
Is Mr. Shalini on there? Can you find him?
No, I'm trying to see.
Let me count how many are in the band. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve.
He's a seven, eight, nine, nine, nine.
And I see two trombones and the two drums and an alto horn and probably a baritone horn. The two trumpets, three trumpets.
That bass horn? Yeah, upright bass.

Yeah, there's a tuba. That's funny. Don't see a clarinet again. There's somebody playing something there. And those two fellas, I can't see what they're playing. One probably is a clarinet. That's a clarinet there. Could that be T.O. by any chance?
Let me see this.
I'll tell you. Did you all get an interview with T.O.?
Not yet. We haven't called him yet. It'll be well within a day. No, that's not T.O. It's not T.O.
I bet you T.O. can tell him most of him musicianette's on there. Yeah, but that's not T.O.
Yeah, that's not T.O. I bet he's good. I'm a runner. Some people would know a few of the others.
Well, maybe he may be a, how do they call him, a northern man on there.
So we know who the three coronets are, Sidney Desvin, you say? I wonder who this guy is.
Sidney Desvin is a coronet. Yeah.
Morat, a nomorized Sidney Desvin. Sidney Desvin.
I don't know none of those. I think that's proper.
I don't know. The drummer almost looks familiar to me, but I can't think.
This drummer, see this drummer here? He looks very familiar.
I really don't know many of those people on there.
Actually, he looks maybe something like Louis Dumaine to me, though.
I think at the time, Vic Gaspar was playing his drummer for him.
Vic would be one of the two trombones. This is a wonderful trombone.
